sanitize_display_name.rules: 1) remove every "<" and ">" character (regex [<>]); 2) .strip() leading/trailing whitespace; 3) truncate to max_len characters.
sanitize_display_name.min_length: not enforced here — /start rejects names shorter than 2 or longer than 20 AFTER sanitizing (len<2 or len>20 → start.name_invalid); nickname rejects <1 or >24

entry_math.random_ivs: NOT uniform: for each of [hp, attack, defense, sp_atk, sp_def, speed]: val = clamp(int(random.gauss(15.5, 7)), 0, 31) (bell curve centered 15.5, sigma 7; extremes rare)
entry_math.random_evs: all six EVs start at 0: {hp:0, attack:0, defense:0, sp_atk:0, sp_def:0, speed:0}

actual_stats_formula.hp: max(1, floor(((2*base + iv + floor(ev/4)) * level / 100) + level + 10))
actual_stats_formula.other: stat = floor(((2*base + iv + floor(ev/4)) * level / 100) + 5); if nature.plus == stat_name -> floor(stat * 1.1); elif nature.minus == stat_name -> floor(stat * 0.9); return max(1, stat)
actual_stats_formula.applied: calc_all_stats over STAT_ORDER [hp, attack, defense, sp_atk, sp_def, speed]; max_hp = actual_stats.hp

exp_for_level.rule: level <= 1 -> 0; unknown growth_rate falls back to medium-fast
exp_for_level.slow: 5 * level^3 / 4  (returned as a float, no int())

learn_moves_for_level.source_moves: dex.moves entries with level == 0 or level <= candidate level
learn_moves_for_level.filter: keep only moves whose fetched power AND accuracy are both real numbers > 0 (status/no-data moves dropped)
learn_moves_for_level.sort: sorted by (-level_learned, name), then truncated to MAX_MOVES = 4
learn_moves_for_level.empty_fallback_pool: if no level-up moves: scan global move index; skip status category; skip blacklist {explosion, self destruct, selfdestruct, hyper beam, giga impact, belch, frustration, return}; require power>0 and accuracy>0; score = (10 if STAB else 1) + power/20; sort desc; take top 4 but avoid a 3rd move of an already-seen type once >=2 moves share types (seen_types skip when len(learned)>=2)
learn_moves_for_level.guarantee: if still empty → [{name: Tackle, type: Normal, power: 40, accuracy: 100, pp: 35, damage_class: physical, level_learned: 1}]

entry_math.ev_yield_calc: best_stat = argmax(base_stats) (single highest stat only); ev_yield[best_stat] = min(3, max(1, floor(best_val / 40)))
entry_math.gender_determination: gender = null when species gender_rate == -1 (gender_rate==-1 names are pre-collected into GENDERLESS_IDS), else random.choice(['Male','Female']) — 50/50; gender_rate itself is only used for genderless detection (display uses format_gender_rate: male=(8-rate)/8*100%, female=rate/8*100%)
entry_math.shiny_hidden_roll: create_pokemon_entry: is_shiny = random.random() < 0.001 (0.10%). generate_spawn OVERRIDES it: roll_shiny() is the only authority — roll < 0.000005 → god_shiny; < 0.000005+0.00005 → ultra_shiny; < 0.000005+0.00005+0.0005 → shiny; else normal, and a normal result forces entry.shiny = False (SHINY_GOD=0.000005, SHINY_ULTRA=0.00005, SHINY_SHINY=0.0005)

modules.title: Getting Started
sections: /mystats — Name, coins, catches & PvP at a glance
/rename <name> — Change your trainer name, e.g. /rename Ash
/query <text> — Report a bug or suggest a feature, e.g. /query hunt lag
/clear — Unstick a frozen battle or trade
/evtrain — Pick a stat to EV train, then /hunt
notes: • regions unlock at trainer level = your gen number

modules.title: Catching & Battle
sections: /hunt — Wild encounter: fight it or throw a ball

data.subpages_note: 4 sub-pages exist: moves (local dex data — implementable offline), evo (needs PokeAPI species + evolution-chain fetches; header "{name} — Evolutions & Forms", lists Evolutions + Forms, "does not evolve" branch), loc (needs PokeAPI encounters fetch; header "{name} — Locations", 8 per page, "No location data available.", Prev/Next), weak (local type-effectiveness chart via _format_weakness; header "{name} Type Weaknesses:"). Port can ship Moves first; Evolutions/Locations need the network data layer, Weakness needs the type chart.
